{{Quote|This is a top secret Chiss Ascendancy installation. Self-sufficient, running in parallel with the aboveground outposts. Paranoia at work.|Raina Temple|<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />}}
'''Zero Station''' was a military outpost established by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at some point prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3665 BBY]], when the Ascendancy alerted the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to a nearby buildup of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] warships that were preparing to strike at the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The enclave remained on Hoth throughout the next several decades. It was a secret facility that was completely self-sufficient and worked in parallel with the surface installations. Though allies of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] kept the existence of the station a well guarded secret.<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />

[[Cipher Nine]] discovered Zero Station after the [[Imperial Agent]] was betrayed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]]. Once there, the [[Cipher Agent]] met [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Raina Temple]] with the two agreeing to help the operative against the traitorous Imperials.<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />
